verdict: Same calories, about ~200 kcal for 2 pieces. Cucur udang wins slightly because of higher protein, so you stay full longer.
why: 2 pieces of pisang goreng and 2 pieces of cucur udang are both about ~200 kcal.
Cucur udang has 5 g of protein, pisang goreng only 2 g. Protein helps you crave less after tea time.
Fat is almost the same: 8 g for pisang goreng, 9 g for cucur udang. Both are deep-fried.
Both are usually bought by the full plastic bag. That's where calories easily double or triple.
when_a: Pisang goreng is okay when you want natural sweetness at tea time. It also gives energy before exercise.
when_b: Cucur udang suits you when you're a bit hungrier and want something savoury.
tip: Buy by the piece, not by the bag. Take 2 pieces, put them on a plate, and keep the rest for other family members.

faq.q: Does chilli sauce with cucur udang add a lot of calories?
faq.a: Chilli sauce adds a little sugar, about 20-40 kcal for a spoon or two. Not much, but a light dip is enough.

faq.q: Pisang goreng is fruit, so why doesn't it win?
faq.a: The banana is a fruit, but the batter and oil add the calories. The low protein makes you hungry again quickly.
